senses.gloss:
शिबिः(विः)
1 A beast of prey.
--2
The birch tree.
--3 N. of a country
(pl).
--4 N. of a king (who is said
to have saved Agni in the form of
a dove from Indra in the form of a
hawk by offering an equal quantity
of his own flesh weighed in a
balance); Mu. 6. 17.

शिबि(वि)का
1 A palanquin,
litter.
--2 A bier.
--3 A raised
platform.

शिबि(वि)रं
1 A camp;
धृष्ट्रद्युम्नः स्वशिबिरमयं याति सर्वे सहध्वं
Ve. 3. 18; Śi. 5. 68.
--2 A royal camp
or residence.
--3 An intrenchment
for the protection of an army.
--4
A kind of grain.
